implementation_notes: `private`/`#private` fields with readonly public surfaces, `ReadonlyArray`/`Readonly<T>` in return positions, and module-level singletons for state. Types are compile-time only, so runtime validation belongs at the boundary of untrusted input.
idiom_name: private fields + Readonly return types + boundary validation
pitfalls: `readonly` on the property but a mutable `Order[]` as its type
